title: Reversible Pseudonymisation of Documents Sent to External LLMs: an Open Bilingual Benchmark and an Engine
abstract: arXiv:2610.34012v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Professionals send working documents to external large language models. A common safeguard is reversible pseudonymisation: personal data are replaced with placeholders before the request and restored locally in the answer. We present an open benchmark of five existing open tools and a regular-expression baseline on Russian and UK English, and an open engine built on the two strongest tools. The benchmark excludes each tool's own authors' dataset from its verdict, compares the engine with each tool on identical datasets for detection, reports masking precision, and tests on a held-out set of synthetic documents whose files, hashes, decision rules, run plan and stopping rule were published before any run. Two local LLMs test whether placeholders survive. All evaluation data are synthetic, and the benchmark was run by the author of the engine; code, data, predictions and raw answers are released. On external datasets no existing tool meets

translated_title: 发送至外部大语言模型文档的可逆假名化处理：一个开放的双语基准测试与一个引擎
translated_abstract: 专业人士会将工作文档发送给外部大语言模型。一种常见的保护措施是可逆假名化：在发送请求之前将个人数据替换为占位符，并在收到回答后在本地将其还原。我们提出了一个开放基准，涵盖五个现有开源工具和一个正则表达式基线，测试语言为俄语和英式英语；同时提出了一个基于两个最强工具构建的开放引擎。该基准在评判时排除了各工具作者自己的数据集，在相同数据集上对该引擎与各工具的检测能力进行比较，报告掩码精度，并在一个留出的合成文档测试集上进行验证——其文件、哈希值、决策规则、运行计划和停止规则均在任何运行开始之前就已公布。研究还使用两个本地大语言模型测试占位符能否在处理中保持有效。所有评估数据均为合成数据，且该基准由引擎作者本人运行；代码、数据、预测结果和原始答案均已公开发布。在外部数据集上，没有任何现有工具达到……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一个针对俄英双语文档可逆假名化工具的开放基准测试，基于预注册的合成数据评估了五个现有工具与正则表达式基线，并构建了一个基于两个最强工具的开放引擎，发现现有工具在外部数据集上均无法达标。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an open bilingual (Russian and UK English) benchmark for reversible pseudonymisation tools used to protect documents sent to external LLMs, evaluating five existing tools and a regex baseline with pre-registered synthetic data, and introduces an open engine built on the two strongest tools, finding that no existing tool meets the standard on external datasets.
